name: projector
prompt: Authentic archival black-and-white photograph, 1920s India: inside a cramped cinema projection booth, an old carbon-arc film projector throwing a sharp cone of light through a small window into darkness, dust particles glowing in the beam, film reels on the spools. Heavy grain, scratches, deep blacks, dramatic chiaroscuro. No people's faces visible. No text, no watermark.

name: talkie1931
prompt: Authentic archival black-and-white photograph, 1931 Bombay film studio: a large vintage carbon microphone hanging from a wooden boom over a film set, a woman singer in a sari singing on set seen in soft focus from the side, harmonium and tabla musicians in the corner, huge studio lamps. Heavy film grain, silver gelatin, faded, scratches. Documentary realism, period accurate. No text, no watermark.

name: dance1950
prompt: Hand-tinted vintage photograph from 1950s India (black-and-white photo with delicate pastel hand colouring - rose, turquoise, gold): a classical dancer in an ornate costume frozen mid-spin on a lavish film studio palace set, skirt flaring, film crew and a big studio camera silhouetted in the foreground. Grain, soft focus, faded paper texture. Face turned away from camera. No text, no watermark.

name: billboard
prompt: 1980s Bombay street, Kodachrome color photograph: a sign painter on bamboo scaffolding hand-painting a gigantic cinema billboard of a heroic action figure (stylized painted fictional hero with windswept hair, fists, flames and explosions in the painting - not resembling any real actor), vivid enamel poster colors, crowds and yellow-black taxis below. Film grain, warm faded color, documentary realism. No legible text, no watermark.

name: milk
prompt: 1990s South India, Kodak color film photograph: ecstatic fans on bamboo ladders pouring milk from steel pots over a towering painted cardboard cutout of a fictional film superstar (stylized, generic, not resembling any real actor), huge flower garlands, confetti in the air, crowd with raised arms, firecracker smoke, drummers. Shot from below, cutout and fans seen mostly from behind. Grain, saturated warm colors, documentary realism. No legible text, no watermark.

name: queue
prompt: 1970s India at dawn, color film photograph: a long snaking queue of men in bell-bottoms and shirts outside the iron-grilled ticket window of an art deco single-screen cinema hall, a small board hanging on the grille, soft blue-pink dawn light, mist, bicycles. Film grain, faded Kodachrome palette, documentary realism. No legible text, no watermark.

name: audience
prompt: 1980s India, inside a packed single-screen cinema hall: the audience seen from the front lit only by the flickering projector light, men standing on seats whistling with fingers, cheering wildly, throwing coins and confetti toward the screen, beam of light through cigarette smoke overhead. Film grain, warm color, motion blur, joyful chaos, documentary realism. No text, no watermark.

name: scripts
prompt: Moody overhead photograph: a tall messy stack of typed film screenplays with dog-eared pages on an old wooden producer's desk, a brass ashtray, a rotary phone, a single desk lamp casting hard shadows, dust, 1990s. Cinematic, desaturated, film grain. No legible text, no watermark.

name: dreamer
prompt: Cinematic modern photograph, 2026 Bengaluru at night: a young Indian filmmaker on a rooftop with a laptop, face lit by a warm screen glow, eyes full of wonder, city skyline bokeh and a light drizzle, deep crimson and teal color grade, anamorphic lens flare, shallow depth of field, shot on ARRI Alexa. No text, no watermark.

name: muskan_director

Crimson and teal grade, shot on ARRI Alexa, 35mm, shallow depth of field. Photorealistic. No text, no watermark.
